blocks.text: Condo buildings in Crescent Beach Ocean Park

Where sources differ: (1) Ocean Park Place's built year conflicts — the building directory states 1979 while MLS listings for its units state 1978. (2) Rockford by Cressey's unit count conflicts — the developer's own feature sheet states 63 condominium residences while presale sources state 60 condominiums — carried as a conflict, not settled, in; Rockford is a presale (estimated completion 2027 on the presale records read), not completed resale stock, and is documented but not counted.
Ocean Park Place — 12890 17 Avenue, Ocean Park

The building directory records the name Ocean Park Place at this address, built 1979, 54 units, with club house, elevator and storage; MLS listings for units at the address record sub-type Apartment/Condo, strata plan NWS1191, complex name "Ocean Park", and built 1978. Directory restrictions: age restrictions; pets not allowed; rentals not allowed — that recorded line is void for long-term rentals under the Nov 24, 2022 rule in. The directory does not state the age in its restriction line; two unit listings describe the building in their text as a "55 PLUS BUILDING" and a "well-managed 55+ community" — listing text only.
Where the condos are and what to know

items.t: Where the condo stock concentrates: in Ocean Park village, not in Crescent Beach village.

"Crescent Beach Ocean Park" in full (MLS® "Crescent Bch Ocean Pk.") is one board sub-area joining two seaside communities — Crescent Beach, a low village at the mouth of the Nicomekl River below the Crescent Heights bluff, and Ocean Park, on the east side of Boundary Bay — and one of nine sub-areas of the Fraser Valley board community "S Surrey White Rock".
White Rock's own bylaws (Zoning Bylaw 2024 No. 2506 / OCP Bylaw 2017 No. 2220) belong to White Rock only and are never applied to a Surrey-address building here.
Community context only (whole S Surrey White Rock community, not this sub-area's prices): Detached median $1,628,000; Condos & Townhomes median $700,000 / $524 per sq ft / 99% sale-to-list / 33 DOM.
Blackie Spit Park at 3136 McBride Avenue; Kwomais Point Park at 1367 128 Street; Crescent Park at 2585 132 Street, a 52-hectare forested park.

The developer's own material disagrees with the presale marketing on Rockford's size. Cressey's feature sheet states 63 condominium residences; presale sources state 60 condominiums with a 10/40/10 bedroom mix — and one presale source addresses the project at 1651 128 Street while MLS records use 1655 128 Street. Confirm the disclosure statement's unit count and the civic address in the contract, not the marketing.

The same townhouse complex carries three directory names and two rental positions. The 16 Avenue complex appears as Ocean Park Courtyards, Courtyard Of Ocean Park and The Courtyards Of Ocean Park across directory address pages (12743, 12751 and 12757 16 Ave), with one page recording "rentals not allowed" and another "rentals allowed w/restrictions" — the registered bylaws, not any directory page, decide it, and the "not allowed" line would in any case be void for long-term rentals.

blocks.text: What Crescent Beach and Ocean Park homes sold for

Between November 7, 2025 and November 6, 2026, 123 detached houses sold in Crescent Beach and Ocean Park at a median of $1,740,000, 13 townhomes at $824,000 and 10 condos at $1,237,500. MLS® sub-area F53 covers Crescent Beach and Ocean Park together, so these figures are for both. In the last six months (May 7 to November 6, 2026), 62 detached houses sold at a median of $1,656,500. The latest sale in the pull was on October 23, 2026.

faq.q: When was Ocean Park Place built — 1978 or 1979?

faq.a: No — on the records read it is a presale by Cressey Development Group at 128 Street and 17 Avenue, a 4-storey concrete low-rise with estimated completion 2027; even its unit count conflicts (63 residences on the developer's feature sheet, 60 condominiums on presale sources). A purchase is a developer contract: GST applies, the Newly Built Home PTT exemption is the one to check, and REDMA gives a 7-day rescission period with deposits in trust.
faq.q: Is Rockford a resale building I can move into?

faq.a: The directory records "age restrictions" without stating the age, and two unit listings call it 55+ in their text; only a 55-or-older bylaw is valid under SPA ss. 123.1/123.2 + Reg 7.01 in any case, with the exemptions in. Read the registered bylaws on the Form B package before relying on any age.

faq.a: Long-term, yes — every BC strata rental-restriction bylaw became void on November 24, 2022. Short-term rentals can still be restricted by bylaw.
